title: Mitigating vendor lock-in with Sakana AI Fugu multi-agent models
summary: Sakana AI launched Fugu, a multi-agent orchestration system designed to help enterprises reduce dependency on single AI vendors by dynamically routing tasks across multiple AI models, addressing the operational vulnerabilities and lock-in risks associated with monolithic AI API dependencies.
problem_solved: Addresses vendor lock-in risks and operational vulnerabilities that enterprises face when relying entirely on monolithic AI APIs from a single provider.
why_valuable: Provides enterprises with flexibility and resilience by enabling dynamic routing across multiple AI models, reducing exposure to single-vendor failures and pricing changes.
